item
List or search for items.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Pass this to list all items in a folder.

params.name: text
params.description: Pass this to perform a full text search for items.

params.name: name
params.description: Pass to lookup an item by exact name match. Must pass folderId as well when using this.

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

info.name: Get a histogram for any region of a large image item.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The ID of the item.

params.name: width
params.description: The maximum width of the analyzed region in pixels.

params.name: height
params.description: The maximum height of the analyzed region in pixels.

params.name: resample
params.description: If false, an existing level of the image is used for the histogram.  If true, the internal values are interpolated to match the specified size as needed.  0-3 for a specific interpolation method (0-nearest, 1-lanczos, 2-bilinear, 3-bicubic)

params.name: frame
params.description: For multiframe images, the 0-based frame number.  This is ignored on non-multiframe images.

params.name: bins
params.description: The number of bins in the histogram.

params.name: rangeMin
params.description: The minimum value in the histogram.  Defaults to the minimum value in the image.

params.name: rangeMax
params.description: The maximum value in the histogram.  Defaults to the maximum value in the image.

params.name: roundRange
params.description: If true and neither a minimum or maximum is specified for the range, round the bin edges and adjust the number of bins for integer data with smaller ranges.

params.name: density
params.description: If true, scale the results by the number of samples.

params.name: cache
params.description: Report on or request caching the specified histogram for all frames.  Scheduling creates a local job.

items.docs: This can take all of the parameters as the region endpoint, plus some histogram-specific parameters.  Only typically used parameters are listed.  The returned result is a list with one entry per channel (always one of L, LA, RGB, or RGBA colorspace).  Each entry has the histogram values, bin edges, minimum and maximum values for the channel, and number of samples (pixels) used in the computation.

info.name: Get any region of a large image item, optionally scaling it.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The ID of the item.

params.name: left
params.description: The left column (0-based) of the region to process.  Negative values are offsets from the right edge.

params.name: top
params.description: The top row (0-based) of the region to process.  Negative values are offsets from the bottom edge.

params.name: right
params.description: The right column (0-based from the left) of the region to process.  The region will not include this column.  Negative values are offsets from the right edge.

params.name: bottom
params.description: The bottom row (0-based from the top) of the region to process.  The region will not include this row.  Negative values are offsets from the bottom edge.

params.name: regionWidth
params.description: The width of the region to process.

params.name: regionHeight
params.description: The height of the region to process.

params.name: units
params.description: Units used for left, top, right, bottom, regionWidth, and regionHeight.  base_pixels are pixels at the maximum resolution, pixels and mm are at the specified magnfication, fraction is a scale of [0-1].

params.name: width
params.description: The maximum width of the output image in pixels.

params.name: height
params.description: The maximum height of the output image in pixels.

params.name: fill
params.description: A fill color.  If output dimensions are specified and fill is specified and not "none", the output image is padded on either the sides or the top and bottom to the requested output size.  Most css colors are accepted.

params.name: magnification
params.description: Magnification of the output image.  If neither width for height is specified, the magnification, mm_x, and mm_y parameters are used to select the output size.

params.name: mm_x
params.description: The size of the output pixels in millimeters

params.name: mm_y
params.description: The size of the output pixels in millimeters

params.name: exact
params.description: If magnification, mm_x, or mm_y are specified, they must match an existing level of the image exactly.

params.name: frame
params.description: For multiframe images, the 0-based frame number.  This is ignored on non-multiframe images.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Output image encoding.  TILED generates a tiled tiff without the upper limit on image size the other options have.  For geospatial sources, TILED will also have appropriate tagging.  Pickle emits python pickle data with an optional specific protocol

params.name: jpegQuality
params.description: Quality used for generating JPEG images

params.name: jpegSubsampling
params.description: Chroma subsampling used for generating JPEG images.  0, 1, and 2 are full, half, and quarter resolution chroma respectively.

params.name: tiffCompression
params.description: Compression method when storing a TIFF image

params.name: style
params.description: JSON-encoded style string

params.name: resample
params.description: If false, an existing level of the image is used for the region.  If true, the internal values are interpolated to match the specified size as needed.  0-3 for a specific interpolation method (0-nearest, 1-lanczos, 2-bilinear, 3-bicubic)

params.name: contentDisposition
params.description: Specify the Content-Disposition response header disposition-type value.

params.name: contentDispositionFilename
params.description: Specify the filename used in the Content-Disposition response header.

items.docs: If neither width nor height is specified, the full resolution region is returned.  If a width or height is specified, aspect ratio is always preserved (if both are given, the resulting image may be smaller in one of the two dimensions).  When scaling must be applied, the image is downsampled from a higher resolution layer, never upsampled.

info.name: Get a thumbnail of a large image item.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The ID of the item.

params.name: width
params.description: The maximum width of the thumbnail in pixels.

params.name: height
params.description: The maximum height of the thumbnail in pixels.

params.name: fill
params.description: A fill color.  If width and height are both specified and fill is specified and not "none", the output image is padded on either the sides or the top and bottom to the requested output size.  Most css colors are accepted.

params.name: frame
params.description: For multiframe images, the 0-based frame number.  This is ignored on non-multiframe images.

params.name: encoding
params.description: Output image encoding.  TILED generates a tiled tiff without the upper limit on image size the other options have.  For geospatial sources, TILED will also have appropriate tagging.  Pickle emits python pickle data with an optional specific protocol

params.name: contentDisposition
params.description: Specify the Content-Disposition response header disposition-type value.

params.name: contentDispositionFilename
params.description: Specify the filename used in the Content-Disposition response header.

items.docs: Aspect ratio is always preserved.  If both width and height are specified, the resulting thumbnail may be smaller in one of the two dimensions.  If neither width nor height is given, a default size will be returned.  This creates a thumbnail from the lowest level of the source image, which means that asking for a large thumbnail will not be a high-quality image.

info.name: Get parameters for using tile_frames as background sprite images.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The ID of the item.

params.name: format
params.description: Optional format parameters, such as "encoding=JPEG&jpegQuality=85&jpegSubsampling=1".  If specified, these replace the defaults.

params.name: query
params.description: Addition query parameters that would be passed to tile endpoints, such as style.

params.name: frameBase
params.description: Starting frame number (default 0).  If c/z/t/xy then step through values from 0 to number of that axis - 1.  The axis specification in only useful for cache reporting or scheduling

params.name: frameStride
params.description: Only use every frameStride frame of the image (default 1).  c/z/t/xy to use the length of that axis

params.name: frameGroup
params.description: Group frames when using multiple textures to keep boundaries at a multiple of the group size number.  c/z/t/xy to use the length of that axis.

params.name: frameGroupFactor
params.description: Ignore grouping if the resultant images would be more than this factor smaller than without grouping (default 4)

params.name: frameGroupStride
params.description: Reorder frames based on the to stride (default 1).  "auto" to use frameGroup / frameStride if that value is an integer.

params.name: maxTextureSize
params.description: Maximum texture size in either dimension.  This should be the smaller of a desired value and of the intended graphics environment texture buffer (default 16384).

params.name: maxTextures
params.description: Maximum number of textures to use (default 1).

params.name: maxTotalTexturePixels
params.description: Limit the total area of all combined textures (default 2**30).

params.name: alignment
params.description: Individual frame alignment within a texture.  Used to avoid jpeg artifacts from crossing frames (default 16).

params.name: maxFrameSize
params.description: If specified, frames will never be larger than this, even if the texture size allows it (default None).

params.name: cache
params.description: Report on or request caching the resultant frames.  Scheduling creates a local job.

info.name: Get a large image tile.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The ID of the item.

params.name: z
params.description: The layer number of the tile (0 is the most zoomed-out layer).

params.name: x
params.description: The X coordinate of the tile (0 is the left side).

params.name: y
params.description: The Y coordinate of the tile (0 is the top).

params.name: redirect
params.description: If the tile exists as a complete file, allow an HTTP redirect instead of returning the data directly.  The redirect might not have the correct mime type.  "exact" must match the image encoding and quality parameters, "encoding" must match the image encoding but disregards quality, and "any" will redirect to any image if possible.
